wholePhysicalScope: Used native OpenStreetMap ways 1119202324 and 306337103 at the south parade frontage, the National Register inventory and the original USGS Rio Hondo bare-earth survey.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the stone arcade, second-floor porch, separate guardhouse and front pediment.
limitations: The two standing south-parade buildings are represented. Rear elevations, roof pitches and small trim lengths are visual estimates.
The parade-ground landscape, barracks, officers’ quarters, other outbuildings and interiors are outside this model.
